initial_state: data/CURRENT.BIN absent in each fresh disposable copy
steps: Copy the repository's data/ and modules/ directories plus dosbox.conf to a new disposable directory; verify the four pinned input hashes and config hash before launch. Other module utilities remain present but are not invoked.
Launch DOSBox-X with the disposable root mounted as N:, switch to N:, cd modules, run NOCTIS.EXE; press Enter if the DOSBox-X boot screen waits.
In the ship view press r (onboard devices), 8 (cartography), 8 (show targets in range). Wait until ADELPHE is highlighted in the target list.
Press Enter; verify that the display shows ADELPHE, S02, and TGT FIXED.
Press Escape to close the list and Escape again to exit normally. Repeat the same sequence from another fresh copy.

Run python3 docs/porting/fixtures/extract_current_target.py on both data/CURRENT.BIN files and compare the documented little-endian target fields; do not compare the entire time-dependent save byte-for-byte.

exploratory_run.notes: A separate fresh-copy run involved help, an abandoned flight-control targeting attempt, then the same cartography selection. It also produced the identical saved target fields; its data-sheet screenshot shows ADELPHE, S02, and radius 0.4540. It is evidence, not one of the two direct-sequence repetitions.

comparison_level: EXACT saved coordinates, class, RGB, spin, and radius f32 bits; TOLERANT starmap double ID; STRUCTURAL screen text
notes: Both direct-sequence repetitions agree on every saved target field. Complete CURRENT.BIN hashes differ, so those whole files are not golden fixtures. The screenshots are evidence, not pixel-exact baselines. Native recomputation of the ID differs from the stored DOS x87-derived double by approximately 2e-12.
